title: Google and Amazon join Microsoft in saying they will keep working with Anthropic on non-defense projects after DOD designated Anthropic a supply chain risk (Jennifer Elias/CNBC)
summary: Jennifer Elias / CNBC: Google and Amazon join Microsoft in saying they will keep working with Anthropic on non-defense projects after DOD designated Anthropic a supply chain risk — Google said it will continue offering Anthropic's artificial intelligence technology for clients, excluding for defense work …
